hub.head_title: Clash of Clans Builder Base Buildings, Costs and Levels
hub.description: Every Builder Base building in Clash of Clans with per-level build cost, build time, hitpoints and Builder Hall requirement.
hub.summary: Every Builder Base building, 31 in total, with the full level table for each one, read from the game files.

entries.name: Air Bombs
entries.description: Air Bombs stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: For heavyweight air defense, Air Bombs do the trick. An endless supply of explosive barrels launch into the sky to ravage flying enemies!
entries.head_title: Air Bombs (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Archer Tower
entries.description: Archer Tower stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: No foe can escape the Archer's arrows. This tower has a special switch - choose long range or fast attack!
entries.head_title: Archer Tower (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Army Camp
entries.description: Army Camp stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Your troops are stationed in Army Camps. Each camp can house only one troop type at a time. Some troops can be upgraded to fit more units per camp!
entries.head_title: Army Camp (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: B.O.B Control
entries.description: B.O.B Control stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Control center for Master Builder's latest invention! Once fully upgraded, B.O.B becomes an additional builder in the Home Village!
entries.head_title: B.O.B Control (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: B.O.T.O’s Shack
entries.description: B.O.T.O’s Shack stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Master Builder saved this little guy from the scrap heap. Despite a few loose screws, B.O.T.O is eager to help with tasks around Builder Base!
entries.head_title: B.O.T.O’s Shack (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Battle Copter
entries.description: Battle Copter stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Get to the Copter! Tired of hammering through walls, Master Builder's next-generation flying machine lets him soar over them. The Battle Copter attacks from afar with its powerful Cannons; or can get up close and personal when using its Bomb Rush ability.
entries.head_title: Battle Copter (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Battle Machine
entries.description: Battle Machine stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: This massive machine broke attempting to hoist the realm's biggest hammer. With some repairs, it could be taken into battle!
entries.head_title: Battle Machine (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Builder Barracks
entries.description: Builder Barracks stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: The Builder Barracks trains troops for Builder Battles! You can also quickly swap troops immediately before attacking. Upgrade the Builder Barracks to unlock more troop types!
entries.head_title: Builder Barracks (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Cannon
entries.description: Cannon stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: The iconic ground defense, built to last! This classic makes the Master Builder a bit sentimental.
entries.head_title: Cannon (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Clock Tower
entries.description: Clock Tower stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: The Clock Tower makes things happen faster in your village! Collect resources, research and build faster.
entries.head_title: Clock Tower (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Crusher
entries.description: Crusher stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: The Crusher REALLY likes its personal space. This hulking stone slams ground units with a mighty wallop!
entries.head_title: Crusher (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Double Cannon
entries.description: Double Cannon stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Double Cannons, double shots per Cannon, It's a double-double dose of trouble!
entries.head_title: Double Cannon (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Elixir Collector
entries.description: Elixir Collector stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Elixir is pumped from Ley Lines coursing underneath your village. Upgrade your Elixir Collectors to maximize Elixir production.
entries.head_title: Elixir Collector (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Elixir Storage
entries.description: Elixir Storage stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: These storages contain the Elixir pumped from underground. Upgrade them to increase the maximum amount of Elixir you can store.
entries.head_title: Elixir Storage (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Firecrackers
entries.description: Firecrackers stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Keep flying pests away with flurries of small rockets! It's like a bug zapper, but prettier.
entries.head_title: Firecrackers (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Gem Mine
entries.description: Gem Mine stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Gem Mines access a rare deposit of this highly valuable resource! Mining Gems is slow and hard work.
entries.head_title: Gem Mine (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Giant Cannon
entries.description: Giant Cannon stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Nothing gets in the way of the Giant Cannon. Its mammoth-sized cannon balls push past anything and just keep going and going and going...
entries.head_title: Giant Cannon (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Gold Mine
entries.description: Gold Mine stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: The Gold Mine produces Gold. Upgrade it to boost its production and Gold Storage capacity.
entries.head_title: Gold Mine (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Gold Storage
entries.description: Gold Storage stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: All your precious Gold is stored here. Don't let sneaky Goblins anywhere near! Upgrade the storage to increase its capacity and durability against attacks.
entries.head_title: Gold Storage (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Guard Post
entries.description: Guard Post stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Houses troops to aid in defense! These rabble rousers are sure to slow down the enemy.
entries.head_title: Guard Post (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Healing Hut
entries.description: Healing Hut stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Brews up a hearty and nourishing cauldron of soup following Master Builder's grandma's recipe. Troops eat some on their way to the next stage of an attack, recovering some of their health.
entries.head_title: Healing Hut (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Hidden Tesla
entries.description: Hidden Tesla stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Part tower, part trap, completely shocking! Zap air and ground foes alike with the power of science!
entries.head_title: Hidden Tesla (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Lava Launcher
entries.description: Lava Launcher stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Hurls molten rock over great distances. Sets the ground on fire, which really turns up the heat for enemy ground troops!
entries.head_title: Lava Launcher (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Mega Tesla
entries.description: Mega Tesla stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: What happens when a Tesla goes Mega? Its powerful jolt deals heavy damage to even the toughest units!
entries.head_title: Mega Tesla (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Multi Mortar
entries.description: Multi Mortar stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Fires long range splash damage multiple times to maximize chances of hitting its target!
entries.head_title: Multi Mortar (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: O.T.T.O's Outpost
entries.description: O.T.T.O's Outpost stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: O.T.T.O´s home and the main building of the second stage. May contain additional feisty robots.\n\nDestroying O.T.T.O´s Outpost awards an extra star in attacks.
entries.head_title: O.T.T.O's Outpost (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Reinforcement Camp

entries.summary: Reinforcement Camps provide helpful reinforcements during battles when reaching the corresponding stage.

entries.name: Roaster
entries.description: Roaster stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Bathe foes with a fiery flood of scalding plasma! Both air and ground troops will feel the burn!
entries.head_title: Roaster (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: Star Laboratory
entries.description: Star Laboratory stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: The Star Laboratory searches the heavens for secrets to unlock a troop's full potential. Improve troop hitpoints, damage and housing space in addition to special troop abilities!

entries.name: Wall
entries.description: Wall stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: Walls are great for keeping your village safe and your enemies in the line of fire.
entries.head_title: Wall (Builder Base) — Clash of Clans Wiki

entries.name: X-Bow
entries.description: X-Bow stats for every level in the Clash of Clans Builder Base: build cost, build time, hitpoints and the Builder Hall each level needs.
entries.summary: The X-Bow shoots powerful bolts with terrifying power. You can set it to target ground units or air units.
